description: Western Australian Petroleum Pipeline Polygons (DMIRS-007) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety. WAPSTATEPIPEPOLYGONPRDVW digital dataset contains current West Australian State Petroleum and Gas Pipelines Polygons pertinent to the Petroleum Submerged Lands Act 1982 (PSLA82) and Petroleum Pipelines Act 1969 (PPA69). The data is held in GDA94 latitude and longitude coordinates. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety. Its tags are Gas, Mining, PPA69, PSLA82, Petroleum. It offers 8 resource(s) in API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, FGDB, GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
